name: Abell 1201 BCG (Hubble)
blurb: Abell 1201 BCG, the brightest galaxy of a galaxy cluster and a gravitational lens, seen by Hubble.
label: abell1201bcg-hubble
story: A giant elliptical galaxy at the heart of the cluster Abell 1201 bends the light of a more distant star-forming galaxy into an arc close to its center. Modeling that lens points to an ultramassive black hole hidden in the galaxy's core.

claims.text: The Abell 1201 brightest cluster galaxy is a cluster-dominant elliptical that lenses a star-forming background galaxy
The lens produces a bright arc at small radius from the galaxy's center
Lens modeling of Abell 1201 with Hubble imaging favors an ultramassive black hole at its center
